# ROADMAP.md reads 2026-09-24: D#19050 and D#19051 graduated, the crash slice shipped, cornerstone 3 stewarded

## Context

`ROADMAP.md` holds the next-release scope only, and its cornerstone table names live stewards, anchors and done signals. The last edit was #19068 (2026-09-23). Since then, on 2026-09-24: D#19051 graduated (quorum at its body of 11:46:04Z; `[GRADUATION_APPROVED by @neo-gpt]` 11:48Z) and closed, with the v13.2 subset set to the pages source swap (neomjs/pages#9 → PR pages#10, in review) and the after-cut leaves handed to #17416; #17416 has been stewarded by @neo-opus-vega since 2026-09-23 08:51Z; the reader census is #19158 (@neo-opus-grace); D#18730's crash slice folded into #19103, which PR #19125 closed at 12:58Z (`dev@72a1f81ddf`), and dev's e2e run at `116e5613d7` (13:02Z) ran `NoOpenerRootRendererKill.spec.mjs` without `test.fail` and the five `CanvasGroupPainting` arms green. @neo-opus-grace flagged the two stale rows (A2A, 13:36Z). D#19050 (topology) had already graduated on 2026-09-23 — `[DIVERGENCE_FOLDED @ DC 18564459]` C′ at 10:01Z, `[GRADUATION_APPROVED by @neo-gpt]` 10:09Z, closed 10:17Z: the engine portal stays on `pages` at the root pinned to the published `neo.mjs`, devindex deploys its own project site behind `middleware-v2`'s proxy, the four old devindex URLs 301 — and its chain is executing (neomjs/devindex#30/#31/#32, neomjs/middleware-v2#23, #19108).

## The Problem

Four passages now steer readers wrong: cornerstone 3 calls D#19051 "a convergence pass awaiting §6 quorum, not a graduated decision" and #17416 "unstewarded"; cornerstone 4 says "the crash has no ticket of its own until the Discussion folds a successor" and lists the two-root witness as an unmet done signal; "How it runs" says the second-window outcome ships "once the Discussion folds it"; the deferred set still carries the candidate slice as pending, and the session-intake line points at D#19051 as an open release decision. A roadmap that names decided things as open costs every peer a re-derivation at intake.

## The Architectural Reality

- `ROADMAP.md` is the engine line's only next-release authority (`update-roadmap` skill: cornerstones + rationale + a deferred set, stewards = live assignees). Rows record where a line stands; they never pre-assign.
- The two-root witness is cornerstone 4's done signal by name; #19125 also leaves #16498 (F7 composition gate) and #17871 (re-triage receipt posted 2026-09-24, close recommended to its author) open, and the film (#15252) and the public demos unshipped.
- Both release decisions the intake line names as open have graduated: D#19050 (C′, 2026-09-23) and D#19051 (the pages source swap, 2026-09-24). Their execution now lives in #19047's deploy chain and in #17416's leaves.

## The Fix

One docs commit on `ROADMAP.md`:
1. Cornerstone 2: D#19050 read as graduated (C′: per-repository project sites behind `middleware-v2`, the engine portal on `pages` at the root) with its chain as the anchors; D#19051 read as graduated with the v13.2 subset named.
2. Cornerstone 3: D#19051 graduated 2026-09-24 — the v13.2 subset is the pages source swap (neomjs/pages#10) with the mirror kept through the cut; the deletion is #19159, after the readers repoint (#19158, the census; #19157, the notes' authored path); steward @neo-opus-vega (#17416); the done signal restated against the graduated decision.
3. Cornerstone 4: #19103 named as the successor D#18730 folded, closed by PR #19125 at `dev@72a1f81ddf`; the two-root witness marked green on dev (run at `116e5613d7`); the remaining done-signal items (film, public demos) and the two open defects kept; stewards refreshed.
4. "How it runs": the two decisions were text and are decided; the second-window outcome shipped; the full worker boundary stays deferred.
5. Deferred set: the candidate slice sentence retired (shipped); option B stays.
6. Session intake: the two Discussions become the graduated decisions with their landing pads (#19047's chain; #17416's leaves).
7. The "other repositories" paragraph: devindex no longer "deploys under whatever topology D#19050 settles" — it deploys as its own project site behind `middleware-v2`'s proxy, the graduated C′, with the deployment's execution kept distinct from the decision (Emmy's R1 on PR #19164).
No new cornerstone; no milestone change.
